name: Takanashi Shiori
source:
Shiori is [url=/c69021]Nozomu's[/url] childhood friend and has been living alone in an apartment for a few years because her parents are too busy with their work. A model student with excellent grades, an independent girl, kind and cute, Shiori has all the assets that will make any boy melt with love.

When she learns that her best friend will start living alone as soon as he enters university, she offers to teach him how to cook and take care of a place to live, in addition to helping him study for his exams by inviting him to come and live with her for a while...

In Aikagi ~After Days~
Bust-Waist-Hips: 85-57-86cm
